parent_objective: design bounded public rollout protocol over M1680 specs before execution
blocked_by: rollout protocol must address metadata-role and unspecified-window caveats before execution

public_gates: M1682 must design rollout protocol without executing rollout
M1682 must include all_72_specs and explicit_window_subset strata
M1682 must preserve L1 L2-current-tiled and L3-reset controls
M1682 must keep one fixed recipe across controller profiles
M1682 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs bounded public rollout protocol over audited task-source specs before execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design drops explicit-window or all-spec strata
stop if control-substitution profiles are not mandatory
stop if profile-specific tuning is allowed
stop if execution or private holdout is admitted directly
fallback_plan: route to no-rollout protocol preflight if design is feasible
route to explicit-window subset repair if caveats dominate
route to task-source spec repair if rollout design cannot preserve controls
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1681 audits M1680 and admits rollout design only

admission_evidence: M1681 audits M1680 as clean enough for rollout design with all_72_specs and explicit_window_subset strata
allowed_updates: M1682 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for no-rollout rollout-protocol preflight if design passes

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; rollout protocol must explicitly evaluate L1 current response, L2 current-tiled, and L3 reset controls.
history_necessity_tests: design must require L2 normal versus current-tiled metrics
design must require L3 online versus reset metrics
design must not claim self-identification until rollout evidence exists
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1680 specs and M1681 audit only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If controls solve the generated tasks, record a valid reactive/finite-window result rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded public rollout protocol can be designed over M1680 specs while preserving caveat strata and controller-family controls before execution.
success_criteria: design includes all_72_specs and explicit_window_subset strata
design chooses one no-rollout protocol preflight or stop route
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design omits caveat strata or control-substitution profiles
design routes directly to rollout execution private holdout promotion or paper evidence
design claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
decision_rule: M1682 passes if it designs a bounded rollout protocol and keeps execution blocked.
